title: Webhooks, exports and analytics bridge
description: Use when LPM must send data out: outgoing webhooks (create, test, debug failed deliveries), data exports or backups (exportar dados), or the analytics bridge to BigQuery. Writes need an API key. Not for incoming GitHub commit tracking (use lpm-deliver-activity).
doneWhen: The webhook delivers (`system.test` delivered, `lastError` null), the export is ready, or the bridge run completed with per-entity results.
authorityCeiling: Webhook create/update/delete are [O]; test, export and bridge runs are [C]. All writes need a full/custom key.
